mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 3.0%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 118.0 and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 5 trading days as the Fed's actions dampen economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by payroll employment above 132.5 million, is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it supports consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 132.5 million.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 2200 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 2200.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 195.0) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) signals an inflationary environment without monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 195.0 and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 118.0), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 5 trading days as it signals a contraction in the real economy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 118.0.
